name: Plum wine
summary: Rượu mơ is plum wine, the second of three drinks poured at the tree stalls under Silver Waterfall.
origin: Sa Pa, at the Silver Waterfall stalls.
howToEat: Drink it with the stall snacks after the falls walk.
where: The tree stalls under Silver Waterfall, about 12 km from town toward Ô Quy Hồ.
seoTitle: Plum wine in Sapa — under the falls trees
seoDescription: Rượu mơ, plum wine, at the Silver Waterfall tree stalls beside táo mèo and san lùng wine.
